description: acme/lantern's release feed, as GitHub serves releases.atom: v2.4.0 and v2.3.0 before the run. Then v2.4.0 is edited (a typo in its notes fixed): the same entry with a later updated time, so the trigger fires on it with update: true. A learned note says v2.4.0 was announced.
